data.name: Vikas Tiwari
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Vikas Tiwari has made a big mark in cricket. With 345 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 79, with an average of 20.10 and a quick strike rate of 159.06. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 83 sixes and 686 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 762.1 overs, taking 340 wickets at an economy rate of 8.55. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
